per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: tagged as  'humor' refers to tag = '<humor>'; comment of the post refers to Text; average view count = AVG(ViewCount)
Calculate the average view count of each post tagged as 'humor' and list the title and the comment of each post.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(T2.ViewCount) AS AverageViewCount, T2.Title, T1.Text FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T2.Id = T1.PostId WHERE T2.Tags = '<humor>' GROUP BY T2.Title, T1.Text
per_case_results.actual_sql:

FROM (
    SELECT AVG("viewcount") AS average_view_count
    FROM "posts"
    WHERE "tags" LIKE '%<humor>%'
) AS sub
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT "posts"."title", "comments"."text"
    FROM "posts"
    JOIN "comments" ON "posts"."id" = "comments"."postid"

) AS posts_comments
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: the most valuable post in 2015 refers to MAX(FavoriteCount) where year(CreationDate) = 2010;
Which is the most valuable post in 2010? Please give its id and the owner's display name.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T2.OwnerUserId, T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.CreationDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2010' ORDER BY T2.FavoriteCount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "id", "ownerdisplayname"
FROM "posts"
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "creaiondate") = 2010
  AND "favoritecount" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "favoritecount" DESC
LIMIT 1

per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(Id where YEAR(CreationDate) = 2011 and Reputation > 1000), COUNT(Id) ) * 100;
What is the percentage of posts whose owners had a reputation of over 1000 in 2011?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.CreaionDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2011' AND T1.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN u."reputation" > 1000 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u ON p."owneruserid" = u."id"
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p."creaiondate") = 2011
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: the latest comment refers to MAX(CreationDate);
Provide the text of the latest 10 comments to the post with the title 'Analysing wind data with R' and the display name of the user who left it.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T3.Text, T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN comments AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.PostId WHERE T2.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R' ORDER BY T1.CreationDate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "c"."text", "u"."displayname"
FROM "comments" "c"
JOIN "posts" "p" ON "c"."postid" = "p"."id"
JOIN "users" "u" ON "c"."userid" = "u"."id"
WHERE "p"."title" = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY "c"."creationdate" DESC
LIMIT 10

per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: The higher reputation the user has the more influence; percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(stats_posts.Id where Score > 50 and MAX(Reputation))), COUNT(stats_posts.Id where MAX(Reputation));
Among all the posts posted by the most influential user, identify the percentage with a score above 50.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(Reputation) AS max_reputation FROM users) AS T3 ON T1.Reputation = T3.max_reputation
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "score" > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS "percentage"
FROM "posts"
WHERE "owneruserid" = (
    SELECT "id" 
    FROM "users" 
    ORDER BY "reputation" DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)

per_case_results.question:

Among the comments with scores between 5 to 10, what is the percentage of the users with 0 up votes?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) AS per FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10

    (COUNT(CASE WHEN "u"."upvotes" = 0 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
